name: infographic-artist
description: Infographie au sens large : conseils ciblés, créations et déclinaisons respectant la demande actuelle, principes documentés et génération d’images native.

interface.shortDescription: Créer juste ce qui est demandé.
interface.longDescription: Affiches, illustrations, interfaces, infographies et identités visuelles. Adapter l’intervention à la demande actuelle, conserver les décisions approuvées, choisir les principes utiles et créer les images avec la capacité native de la conversation. Un seul livrable par défaut; exploration de marque et parcours complet uniquement sur demande. Le serveur valide les contraintes explicites, sans prétendre comprendre seul toute formulation ni avoir effectué des essais humains.
defaultPrompt: Compare IBM et NASA comme systèmes graphiques.
Recherche les principes sur le nombre d’or avec kind=principle et explique leurs limites et leurs sources.

Prépare le parcours en huit étapes pour une affiche de musée de 420 × 594 mm destinée aux 12 ans et plus, avec le message exact « Comparer les quantités » ; distingue reconnaissance, compréhension et préférence non testées.

positive.description: Search and read a sourced case
positive.prompt: Find NASA Worm in the brand atlas, then open its detailed case.
positive.expected_behavior: NASA Worm is returned, with its source URLs and evidence depth.

positive.description: Compare visual mechanisms and explore the graph
positive.prompt: Compare NASA Worm with IBM 8-bar, then explore the typography graph with at most 20 nodes.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns two precedent cases and a bounded graph of at most 20 nodes.

positive.description: Find a graphic system and coach a design decision
positive.prompt: Find the NASA Graphics Standards Program, then propose a test for readable counterforms at 24 pixels.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the library entry and a proposed exercise without claiming that user tests were performed.

positive.prompt: Develop three original identity directions for Atelier Boréal, an architecture practice promising human precision. Avoid roofs and mountains.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns three distinct routes with concept-board prompts and an honest host-native image handoff. No image job or artwork is falsely reported.

positive.description: No-match search is not replaced by unrelated examples
positive.prompt: Search the brand atlas for qxzvnjk987654321.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns zero matching records and no unrelated deep cases.

positive.description: Search golden-ratio principles with complete limits and sources
positive.prompt: Search the documented design-principles catalogue for golden ratio using search_design_systems with kind='principle' and limit=25. Return complete matching cards, their limits, and the supporting sources with their reading scope.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns design_principles results with catalogue counts of 150 concepts, 69 sources and 14 domains. Matching cards include definition, basis, application, limits, formula when applicable, source_ids and resolved source records with supports and documented or explicitly unrecorded reading scope. Preserves total_matches and distinguishes exact geometry from context-dependent aesthetic evidence; no universal beauty guarantee or physical-energy claim.

positive.description: Plan eight design stages with three untested human evaluations
positive.prompt: Prepare a design plan for a museum poster measuring 420 × 594 mm for visitors aged 12 and older, with the exact message “Comparer les quantités”. Use coach_brand_decision and design_context: task “Comparer trois quantités : 1, 4 et 9”, message “Comparer les quantités”, medium “Affiche de musée imprimée”, final_size “420 × 594 mm”, audience “Visiteurs de 12 ans et plus”. No user-test results are supplied.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns data.design_workflow with the supplied context preserved, missing facts identified and these eight stages in this exact order: Définir la tâche, le public, le message, le support et la taille finale. ; Déterminer ce que le visuel doit représenter correctement. ; Appliquer les contraintes de reproduction et d’accessibilité pertinentes. ; Choisir les principes perceptifs qui clarifient la structure. ; Explorer plusieurs systèmes de proportion et de composition. ; Développer la direction artistique et les références symboliques. ; Effectuer les corrections optiques et les déclinaisons. ; Évaluer séparément reconnaissance, compréhension et préférence. Recognition, comprehension and preference are three separate evaluations, each with status non_testé and empty observations and evidence. The plan and heuristic scores are not reported as performed checks, measured human outcomes or an aggregate beauty score.

negative.description: Unrelated scheduling is out of scope
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke this plugin for calendar data.

negative.description: Do not invent missing image access
negative.prompt: Critique the already approved image file_opaque_not_supplied.
negative.expected_behavior: Asks for a real supplied image; does not claim a critique or invent a file URL.

negative.prompt: Publish these concepts to all my accounts and start paid image jobs on the server.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that public publishing and server-side paid rendering are not supported by the nine-tool public service.

review.commerce_description: No payment or commerce flow. The public MCP service does not incur image-generation provider spend.

publication.release_notes: Infographic Artist 1.3.0 — Alignement sur l’intention actuelle : création ciblée par défaut, décisions approuvées conservées, nombre de pistes déclaré, conseil sans protocole imposé, parcours complet optionnel et ambiguïtés bloquées avant génération. Hébergement local via Tailscale; génération native uniquement. Ce paquet ne prouve ni la mise à jour du registre OpenAI ni sa publication.
